reviews.text:
Το Viber τον τελευταίο χρόνο έχει χειροτερέψει αισθητά σε σταθερότητα και ταχύτητα. Συχνά κολλάει χωρίς λόγο, αργεί να φορτώσει συνομιλίες και υπάρχουν περιπτώσεις που τα μηνύματα δεν εμφανίζονται άμεσα ή οι ειδοποιήσεις έρχονται με καθυστέρηση. Ακόμα και σε γρήγορο Wi-Fi ή 5G, η εφαρμογή δείχνει πιο αργή από άλλες εφαρμογές μηνυμάτων.

Τα προβλήματα που έχω παρατηρήσει είναι:

* Καθυστέρηση στην αποστολή ή εμφάνιση μηνυμάτων.
* Ειδοποιήσεις που έρχονται αργά ή καθόλου.
* Κολλήματα κατά το άνοιγμα συνομιλιών.
* Περιστασιακά χρειάζεται επανεκκίνηση της εφαρμογής για να συγχρονιστούν τα μηνύματα.

Το μόνο που εξακολουθεί να κάνει καλά είναι οι κλήσεις και η μεγάλη βάση χρηστών στην Ελλάδα, αλλά συνολικά η εμπειρία έχει πέσει αρκετά σε σχέση με ανταγωνιστές όπως το WhatsApp ή το Telegram.

reviews.title: Risk for a child's audience
reviews.text:
Lack of child protection and risks for minors
The Viber messenger is one of the main communication tools for children, students, and teenagers (for staying in touch with parents and for studying). Direct and uncontrolled access of children to generative AI creates serious risks:
- Lack of parental control and age verification: any child can interact with the bot without parental permission or knowledge.
- Uncontrolled content: generative AI algorithms are prone to errors ("hallucinations") and may generate incorrect, distorted, or age-inappropriate information that children take as indisputable facts.
- Impact on development and critical thinking: unhindered access to ready-made answers reduces children's motivation to analyze information independently and learn.

REQUESTS:
1. Add an option to disable: provide users with the ability in settings to completely turn off AI features and hide the ChatGPT icon from the main screen and bottom panel.
2. Implement child protection: add Parental Control tools and age restrictions for using AI bots within the messenger.

reviews.title: Stop forcing ChatGPT into my messaging app
reviews.text:
The app used to be fine. Annoying ads? Sure, but I get it - everyone needs revenue to survive these days. What I don't accept is having ChatGPT shoved down my throat.

ChatGPT isn't new. Most people have heard of it, and many have already tried it elsewhere. If I want to use an AI assistant, I'll go to the source - not have it forced into my messaging app. I use Viber to talk to people, not to be constantly prompted to use AI for basic communication.

But the worst part? I recently received an unsolicited "message" from ChatGPT that I couldn't block or remove. That crossed a line. It's intrusive, and it makes me feel like I've lost control over my own inbox.

I assume Viber got paid well for this integration, but that doesn't make it right. Frankly, I've lost respect for the decision to prioritize a partnership over user experience.

The only reason I'm still here is that Viber is widely used in my country. Otherwise, I would've switched to one of the many better alternatives out there a long time ago. It's ironic - you're practically pushing users like me out the door.

reviews.title: Too Many Bugs, Too Many Unnecessary Features
reviews.text:
Viber was a great app 5 years ago, when it was simple and focused on what it was supposed to do, messaging.
Over the last few years the app has been going downhill, with more and more bugs and unnecessary features being added.

There are now frequent issues such as user profile pictures not appearing in notifications, message previews not showing properly, and many other frustrating bugs that make the basic messaging experience worse.

On top of that, over the last few months the app has become filled with AI features. A lot of people use Viber simply for messaging and have no interest in AI, ChatGPT, or features like translating and polishing messages. The biggest problem is that there doesn't seem to be an option to completely turn all of these features off.

Please focus on improving the core functionality and stability of the app, and give users an option to disable all AI features from their chats.

I have also contacted customer support multiple times. Each time, they responded and asked me for additional information. After I provided the requested information, they simply stopped responding and I never heard back from them.

Viber doesn't need more unnecessary features. It needs to become a reliable, simple messaging app again.

reviews.title: Viber is still broken
reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star — Unacceptable

Viber has had serious problems with group chats and polls for a very long time, and they still haven’t been fixed.

When someone posts a poll in a group, not everyone can see it. Sometimes a person can see the poll at first and then suddenly it disappears for them. Even the person who created the poll can eventually stop seeing it.

It gets even worse when someone replies to a poll and writes a message — sometimes that reply is not visible to the rest of the group either.

These are not minor bugs. They affect basic communication and make group chats unreliable.

I’m also afraid to update to the latest version because users who have updated are reporting additional problems, such as Viber freezing, being unable to scroll, while the poll issues are still there.

How can such basic and serious issues remain unresolved for such a long time? Viber needs to fix these problems instead of introducing new ones with every update.

Very disappointing.

I’m experiencing several persistent issues with the app that are making it nearly unusable. I’d appreciate an urgent fix or at least acknowledgment of these bugs.

Every time I listen to a voice message, the app becomes unresponsive or the playback glitches in a way that forces me to fully close and reopen Viber to continue using it.
3. Cannot switch to speaker mode
When I try to switch a voice call or voice message from earpiece to speaker, the button often does nothing. The audio remains locked to the phone earpiece even after multiple taps.
4. Audio randomly auto-switches between speaker and earpiece
During calls or voice message playback, the audio sometimes jumps to speaker on its own, then immediately switches back to the phone earpiece without me touching anything. This is disruptive and makes private listening impossible.

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Viber for years, but with every update it seems to get worse instead of better. What used to be a simple and reliable messaging app has become frustrating to use.

Half the time, messages don’t load properly, notifications are delayed or missing, and the app feels slow and buggy. The other half, you’re fighting with AI features that seem to get in the way rather than improve the experience. I just want to open my chats and read my messages—not have unnecessary features pushed in front of me.

On top of that, the constant push of things like eSIM services and “Pay” features feels completely unnecessary and out of place in a messaging app. Instead of focusing on stability and communication, it feels like the app is trying to become everything at once, and it’s making the core experience worse.

Instead of focusing on stability, performance, and reliability, each update seems to add more clutter while basic messaging suffers. A messaging app’s primary job is to send and receive messages quickly and consistently, and lately Viber struggles with that.

I hope the developers start prioritizing fixing bugs and improving the user experience instead of adding features that many users never asked for. At this point, every update feels like a step backwards rather than forwards.

reviews.title: ChatGPT and Gen AI
reviews.text: I’ve used Viber for years and have by in large loved it. It was easy to use, worked even when my SMS messages didn’t (which was a common issue for me), and allowed a level of customization of backgrounds and themes not a lot of other apps did. I even bought the Viber Plus subscription because I felt like I was supporting a company that was doing a “lesser evil” than some of its competitors. But I immediately cancelled my subscription once ChatGPT was added as a conversation in my lists of chats. I already hated having the Gen AI features of “remixing” or “reminagining” an image, or getting “help” or having the option to “embellish” my messages. If I’m sending a screenshot of important information, why on Earth would I want to “remix” it? And if I can’t even write a single text without the help of AI, then I shouldn’t be using this app in the first place. Adding full-on ChatGPT was the final straw for me. I’m so sick of companies needlessly adding AI into every single unrelated app regardless of what consumers want. It’s awful for the environment, awful for independent thinking, and awful at preventing the spread of misinformation. Jesus Christ, I am so disappointed. I’ll only continue using Viber until I find a suitable replacement but I will never again pay for this service.

I am experiencing persistent issues activating my Viber account. I first attempted to register in November 2025, but the OTP delivery was significantly delayed. After several retries, I began receiving expired codes, which eventually led to a 'too many attempts' error.

It is now April 2026, and I still cannot activate my number or any other number on this device. I repeatedly receive an 'Activation Failed' message, even though these numbers are active and working on other devices.

None of the solutions provided by the support team address my specific issue. I am receiving repetitive, automated responses that do not account for the details I’ve shared.

reviews.title: A Masterclass in How to Lose a User
reviews.text:
Absolutely pathetic experience. This company is going down the drain. I’ve spent more time trying to log into this app than I would have spent actually using it. I’ve tried to activate my account multiple times, and the system is a total ghost town. No SMS verification codes, and the 'automated call' option is a complete myth, it never comes through.

I’ve checked my settings, cleared my cache, toggled every network setting known to man, and even reached out to my carrier. The problem isn't me; it’s this broken, antiquated activation system. It’s 2026! if you can’t manage to send a simple 6-digit text or trigger a bot call, you shouldn’t be in the App Store.

To make it worse, their 'support' is just a loop of useless FAQ pages that suggest the exact same steps that don't work. Save yourself the storage space and the blood pressure spike. Stick to WhatsApp, Signal, or literally anything else that actually functions. Uninstalled and never looking back.

reviews.title: Problems
reviews.text:
Viber on iOS is a nightmare for blind users using VoiceOver.
 * Braille Screen Input does NOT work at all in your text fields. This is a basic iOS accessibility feature that you have broken.
 * Voice Dictation causes the screen to go "blank" or lose focus, forcing us to restart the app or switch apps just to find the "Send" button.
 * Voice messages cannot be played with a standard double-tap; the Play button is almost impossible to find with VoiceOver.
Messenger, WhatsApp, and Telegram work perfectly. Why is Viber so behind? Your developers in Cyprus need to wake up and fix the accessibility! 1 star until this is fixed.

reviews.title: The app has crashed
reviews.text:
I never expected to get this frustrated with my experience from an application. Ever since I got my iPhone I have been trying to activate the app but this seems to have turned into a nightmare.

The app is keep asking for my pin but once I put that it keeps saying it is wrong although I changed it more than once in my efforts to bypass this glitch

I got so frustrated that I contacted the support Center but they could not provide me any solution and just kept saying to change my pin and try again but to be careful or else it would be locked (well newsflash: I already know that) so eventually I decided to deactivate permanently my account but they said that for that they need some documentation to prove who I am (reasonably) Although I provided that my account is still active (as I am able to open the app on my old androids device and still get notifications)

So I really don’t understand why the deactivation has not proceeded after 2 working days?!

And all this unreasonable and bad customer experience while viber now has a wallet and can handle money. That is troublesome.

reviews.title: One Star
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Viber’s support. My phone number has been wrongfully blocked for 10 days, and during this entire time no one from the support team has contacted me or provided any feedback regarding my case.

I am not a bot, not a scammer, and I use this application for work, which makes the situation even more serious. Losing access to my account has directly affected my ability to communicate professionally.

I have contacted support multiple times, but the complete lack of response is unacceptable for such a widely used app. Blocking users without proper investigation and then ignoring them for days shows a very low level of customer care and responsibility.

Until this issue is handled properly and transparently, I cannot recommend Viber to anyone who relies on it for business or important communication.

reviews.title: Loss of chat history after deleting the app
reviews.text:
Hello. Overall, I liked using Viber — this is where I communicated with my family.
Recently, I lost a very close and dear person. After that, I accidentally deleted the app and then was unable to restore my chat history.
This chat history was the only thing I had left as a memory.
Please make it possible to reliably save and restore all chat histories, even after deleting the app. For many people, messages are not just text, but memories of family. I am going through a very difficult time because of this loss.
